descripcion_geo: Upper Egypt (southern Egypt), where Jewish communities lived in the post-exilic period. The name means 'southern land' in Egyptian.
importancia_estrategica: Land of the Jewish diaspora in the south of Egypt.

historias.descripcion: After the fall of Jerusalem, Jewish communities were established in Patros (Upper Egypt); the Elephantine papyri document his life.

historias.titulo: Jeremiah warns the Jews of Patros
historias.descripcion: Jeremiah warns the Jewish communities in Patros that their religious syncretism will bring judgment.

historias.titulo: The return of the dispersed of Patros
historias.descripcion: Isaiah prophesies that the Lord will gather his dispersed people from Patros among other places.

personajes.descripcion: He traveled to Egypt and warned the Jews of Patros against syncretism.
He included Patros in the prophecy of the return of the dispersed to Israel.
They lived in Alto Egypt; the Elephantine papyri show a Jewish temple in the region.

contexto_religioso.contexto_lugar: Patros: relevant geographical region in the Old Testament.

judaismo.descripcion: Patros is a symbol of the Jewish diaspora: Israel dispersed to the ends of the known world; but Isaiah promises that God will gather him from there.
judaismo.significado_teologico: Patros is a symbol of the Jewish diaspora: Israel dispersed to the ends of the known world; but Isaiah promises that God will gather him from there.
